pages.text: [#](53341a)Some creatures are better studied after they have stopped moving. The traps are low metal plates: place one closed, then right-click it open. A moment later it is armed; keep your own feet clear.[#]()
pages.title: Creature Traps

pages.text: [#](53341a)Iron and shears. It rests closed when placed. Open it to arm the jaws; once armed it catches living creatures, snaps shut for four damage, and applies strong slowness.[#]()

[#](53341a)Upgrade a Beartrap with Silver, Null Catalysts, and Wolfsbane. Werewolves trigger it; others do not. Beside a Wolf Altar, with a leashed sheep close by, an open Wolftrap can lure a Wolfman on the full moon; catching that beast makes it infectious. It drops nothing when broken.[#]()
